text:
Ava: Morning — quick async standup for the canary handoff.
Ava: Yesterday I finished the KV-eviction guard changes and uploaded canary image `inference:canary-202603`. Verified 95th p50 latency on local infra. No code merge yet.
Ava: Blockers: need a quick CR review on the batching change (PR #4578) — main question is safe defaults for `batch_timeout`.
Ava: Today: request review, coordinate slice 7 warmup, watch metrics during initial 2% ramp.
Ravi: @Ava looking now, I skimmed PR — two nits. Can you add a short note about expected memory bump? :mag: 
Ravi: Also pre-warmed the pool for slice7 in prod-staging, 8 GPUs ready, warmup script ran at 03:10 UTC.
Jordan: Observability: set up a dashboard for kv-cache hit rate + token latency. I linked thresholds to alerts (pager only if latency > 300ms sustained).
Jordan: I saw a small spike during warmup, but steady after. No errors in logs.
Maya: Product: heads-up to Support — we may see degraded paraphrase quality for ~30m during rollout. I'll send a short customer note if anything looks off. :loudspeaker:
Ava: Thanks — leaving FF at 2% for 20m then 10% increments if stable. Can someone rubber-stamp the canary policy? Paste of config:
Ava: ```json
{
  "flag": "new_kv_gating",
  "initial_percent": 2,
  "step": 10,
  "bake_minutes": 20,
  "rollback_conditions": ["error_rate>0.5%","p50_latency_increase>20%"]
}
```
Ravi: lgtm aside from hardcoded `bake_minutes`; suggest 15 for slice7 since prewarm succeeded. :thumbsup:
Jordan: +1 for 15, but keep rollback thresholds. I'll add a synthetic traffic test to the canary watch.
deploy-bot: deploy started inference/canary-202603 -> prod-slice7 at 3061234590
Ava: Deploy looks green so far, no seen 5xx. Watching logs for mem OOM.
Jordan: Noting a single 502 at 3061234660 — looks like transient upstream timeout, not related to model change. Keeping an eye.
Maya: Ping me if we hit >1% error window, I'll escalate to CS.
Ava: Will do. Thanks team — will post another update at +30m. :coffee:
